concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Setup and First End‑to‑End Analysis:T010
concerns.text: T010 (Integration Test – Chunked TNG Download) is defined before its producer tasks (T011 loader, T016 pipeline runner, T017 aggregation) that generate `data/processed/halo_shapes.csv`. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – Statistical Correlation, Binning & Mass Control:T023b
concerns.text: T023b (Binning Statistical Tests) relies on the Bonferroni utility `apply_bonferroni` defined in T024, but T024 is listed after T023b, violating the required producer‑before‑consumer order.
T028 (Sensitivity Sweep Unit Test) references the sweep function defined in T030, yet T028 appears before T030, causing a consumer‑before‑producer dependency.
T035 (Alignment Unit Test) tests functions that are implemented in T036 (Spin & Major‑Axis Calculation). The test is placed before the implementation, breaking the producer‑consumer ordering.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Setup and First End‑to‑End Analysis:T001a
concerns.text: T001a is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but later tasks (e.g., T004, T005, T006) also write into the `code/` package hierarchy. Parallel execution could cause race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
